page.overview:
Who is Basbakhan?

Basbakhan was a male Noghri warrior and bodyguard. After the death of Bolpuhr, he and Olmahk were assigned to be the bodyguards of Leia Organa Solo. He was likely killed by Yuuzhan Vong warriors during the Battle of Duro while guarding Randa Besadii Diori.
